crossRefs.note: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker…

translations.web: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
translations.bsb: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
translations.asv: Let the husband render unto the wife her due: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
